summary: Rob Bowley is “flipping tables in his head” with anger at the current media coverage of the danger of AI killing us all The risk I’m worried about isn’t a future machine deciding to wipe us out. It’s today’s AI, being wired into everything, carelessly and fast.
takeaways: Around the table were FDEs from Snowflake, Anthropic, and a number of startups I’d been reading about, and over the course of the evening it became clear that we were all using the same two words (forward deployed) to describe jobs that had almost nothing in common.
With agentic engineering, lots of folks are reading more code than ever.
Too often agents are deployed in situations where they include the Lethal Trifecta , opening up a gaping security hole.
